question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.
candidate_answer: The proposal submission deadline was **March 25, 2022, at 4:30 p.m. Central Time**. The RFP says proposals had to be received by then. [OPERS Investment Consulting Services RFP, p. 4](Oklahoma_OPERS__2022-02-RFP-Investment-Consulting-Services.pdf)
